package config

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestDisabledConditionAlwaysApplies(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name    string
		options *BuildOptions
		invalid bool
	}{
		{name: "disabled empty reason", options: &BuildOptions{}, invalid: true},
		{name: "disabled supplied reason", options: &BuildOptions{Reason: "not requested"}},
		{name: "enabled empty reason", options: &BuildOptions{Enabled: true}},
		{name: "nil options"},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			err := test.options.Validate()
			if test.invalid {
				require.Error(t, err, "a disabled set still requires the conditional reason")
				return
			}

			require.NoError(t, err)
		})
	}
}
